name: token-usage-inspector
description: Inspect per-turn and per-model-call token usage from local Codex session logs.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect local Codex token usage by task and turn
interface.longDescription: Read native token_usage_record events from local Codex rollout logs and report per-user-turn or per-model-call input, cached input, output, reasoning, and total tokens. Supports snapshots, CSV/JSON export, and live watch without uploading conversation logs.
defaultPrompt: Show token usage for this Codex task.
Inspect token usage for a task ID.
Watch the current task's token usage live.
